bluf: Exposure Ninja is a UK search marketing agency, founded 2012 and fully remote since 2014, selling SEO and AI search optimisation to mid market B2B and B2C brands, with digital PR, PPC, CRM and web builds behind. The record shows it moving hard into AI search: a Pyramid Framework, a 2026 State of AI Search Report, 83 AI search URLs and two Global Agency Awards 2026 titles. The one thing a rival should know: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, and 4 of its 16 named clients are names only. It is likely, with moderate confidence, selling AI visibility faster than it is productising it.
doing:
The positioning line, in the record's words, is an award winning, fully remote search marketing agency driving qualified leads and revenue for B2B and B2C brands through SEO, AI search and PPC. In plain words: a lead generation search shop selling awards and audits. The headline claim is that it was named SEO Agency of the Year and Integrated Search Agency of the Year at the Global Agency Awards 2026; the JSON-LD lists 33 award entries from 2022 to 2026.

Two lines lead at score 3. AI Search / GEO: the H1 targets Google and AI search, the AI SEO page is built on its Pyramid Framework, and the sitemap holds 83 AI search URLs. SEO: the JSON-LD calls it a search agency specialising in SEO, with 11 Global Search Awards. Four core lines sit at score 2: Content & Digital PR (digital PR, link building, copywriting, in house video), Email & CRM (HubSpot pages, three campaign awards), Paid Search (Best US PPC Campaign 2025, a Tool Store Canada ROAS case) and Web & Product (Shopify and WordPress builds, hosting, Stand Out B2C Website of the Year 2025). Proprietary items: the Pyramid Framework, NinjaFlex flexible monthly development hours and the Brand Accelerator workshop programme. No partners are listed.

The AI posture leads with AI search optimisation (GEO and AEO): audits, the Pyramid Framework, the report with finance and beauty editions, LinkedIn webinars; the Horus read scores P1 as making. Pricing: a free SEO review, no prices shown, NinjaFlex hours; the read scores P5 absent, hourly rates rather than outcomes.

Moves: 2014, went fully remote; 2026, the two Global Agency Awards titles; 2026, shortlisted for 12 Global Search Awards, in a news item dated 2026-09-18. The record lists no jobs. Conspicuously absent for an AI search seller: feeds, schema or entity work (P2 absent), AI operator depth (P6 absent) and an llms.txt.
clients:
The Radar files Exposure Ninja's clients as mid market, B2B and B2C, its home market as the UK with no office listed, its verticals as Finance, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Renewables, eCommerce, SaaS, Education and Nonprofit.

The needs read counts 16 clients from 6 case studies and 10 slugs: 12 observed and 4 names only. Organic demand leads the mix at 0.298: Accelex ('Organic Growth Supports FinTech Acquisition'), Master the Curriculum, Takeaway Packaging and Zugu, each titled on organic growth. Local and lead generation, 0.262: Renew and Sustain ('600+ Leads', also B2B), Russell Regulatory Consultants ('279% Lead Growth'), Age Care Bathrooms ('8,226 Leads'), Service Professionals (also organic) and Transparent, a 'Lead Generation Website for Global SaaS' also coded B2B and web. The Tool Store Canada reads paid and commerce ('Google Ads'), Pyramid Eco paid, brand and web ('Conversion Rate Increase'), Black History Walks web build ('Website Redesign'). Brand and creative, 0.126, is likely overstated (moderate confidence): all five codes rest on titles calling the client a 'Brand' ('Home Services Brand'), not on brand work.

The 4 names only, The Ordinary ('395% ROI'), Value Capital Funding ('640% More Quality Conversions'), Elite Renewables ('326% More Conversions') and Regain Hearing ('534% Revenue Increase'), carry results in the title but no codable need, so need is inferred from the organic and AI search lead.

One client shops: Zugu also sits with canopy-management.

Horus places Exposure Ninja best for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation): with organic and lead needs observed, it is likely, moderate confidence, that these clients ask next for that growth shown in AI citations, which the P1 making read says it sells. Under KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), its deepest exposure, it is likely they price the SEO and content hours against automation.
house: Say and do: 2 of 3 tested lines hold. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt while its sitemap holds 83 AI topic URLs, the one gap flagged. Paid Search is corroborated: 19 Google ads in the Transparency Center, all video, 0 in the last 30 days, advertiser exposure trading ltd, last shown 2026-06-27. Publishing cadence is corroborated and heavy: 367 of 1,132 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 383 in 365. It blocks no AI crawlers. LinkedIn: 5 company ads and 0 thought leader ads; one reads 'What do Bosch, Expedia, and Chanel all have in common? They're all dominating the answers in AI platforms', and the others sell a webinar on buyers using AI in purchasing decisions. The stack is gtm, hubspot, ms_clarity and cookieyes on WordPress; no social pixels, no test tools. Its own YouTube channel is recorded as central to its marketing.
market:
The Horus read: tailwind index 3.2, band Neutral, 27th percentile, integrity 66.7. Best placed for KJ1 (The click is being replaced by the citation, net 0.34), driven by AI Search / GEO at +2 and Content & Digital PR at +1, and for KJ2 (ads inside AI answers, net 0.243). Most exposed to KJ6 (The agency middle is being hollowed out, net -0.6), SEO, Paid Search and Content & Digital PR at -1. Best fit: The Toll Road at 44/100. P moves: making P1 and P7; partial on P4; absent on P2, P5 (it publishes hourly rates), P6 and P8.

The Monsoon read: index 62.0, band Onshore wind, 74th percentile, migration 59.5 against displacement 64.5. The verdict puts 60 of the index on the sold mix, SEO (15) and Web & Product (10) carrying the most movable hours, and sends 65% of the work to South and Southeast Asia, 20% to Eastern Europe and 15% to Africa and the Maghreb. The class is inferred, with no hub office and the in house video line read as an onshore claim.
openings:
The contradiction to lead with is observed: Exposure Ninja sells AI search optimisation as its lead line, with 83 AI search URLs, and publishes no llms.txt on its own domain. It is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival who shows a finance or legal prospect that gap beside the 2026 awards wins the AI search conversation, since the Horus read credits it with P1 and the house is the only soft spot. The falsifier: an llms.txt at exposureninja.com at the next compile.

Second, price. The read scores P5 absent because it publishes hourly rates; with Monsoon displacement at 64.5, it is very likely, with moderate confidence, that an outcome priced or offshore delivered rival undercuts the SEO and web hours, and the in house delivery claim is a claim to test in the sales room.

Third, the book and the machine layer. 4 of 16 names are names only, the question to ask its clients; Zugu already sits on canopy-management. No feed, schema or entity work shows (P2 absent) on a core search line, and paid media runs without first party data, creative volume or measurement depth (P4 partial, P8 absent).
watch: I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would deepen the KJ6 exposure on its SEO, paid search and content hours.

I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of its SEO core, while growth above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and its KJ1 tailwind.
I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the next milestone ($2B) and any pricing below $20 CPM would change the KJ2 read on its paid search line, where P8 is absent.
The 2026-09-18 news item on 12 Global Search Awards 2026 shortlistings is the dated move to follow: whether they convert into wins and into case studies with described work.
The next Radar compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients, and this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile.
